title: FEDformer: Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer for Long-term Series Forecasting
grouping: Two dashed grey rectangles, encoder above and decoder below, each named in plain text at its lower-left ('FEDformer Encoder', 'FEDformer Decoder') with 'N×' / 'M×' in the top-right; a single wire runs from the encoder's right end down into the decoder's attention block. Blocks are coloured by kind: light green frequency block, pale yellow decomposition blocks, grey feed-forward, pink frequency attention.
shapes_depth: Square-cornered flat boxes with thin dark outlines and fills; inputs are stadium (pill) shaped terminals 'Encoder Input', 'Seasoal Init', 'Trend Init' with their tensor shapes typeset below (e.g. X ∈ R^{I×D}). Residual skips are right-angle lines over each block into hollow circled pluses. Every wire is labelled with a math symbol for the seasonal or trend state of that layer (S_en^{l,1}, T_de^{l,1}), and the decoder's trend runs as a separate bottom lane of circled pluses fed by down-arrows from each decomposition block. No series are drawn.
proposed_highlight: The frequency-enhanced block and attention carry the only saturated fills (green, pink); decomposition is pale yellow and feed-forward neutral grey, and the caption names the green block. The same encoder-over-decoder skeleton with a trend lane is kept, so the new blocks read as substitutions in a familiar frame.
lesson: Label each wire with the layer's seasonal and trend symbols (S^{l,k}, T^{l,k}) so the decomposition bookkeeping is read off the arrows, and give the decoder's trend its own bottom lane summed by circled pluses.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first-page footer (ICML 2022, PMLR 162). 'Seasoal' is the figure's own spelling.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two dashed grey frames stacked vertically - 'FEDformer Encoder' (N x) above, 'FEDformer Decoder' (M x) below - each a left-to-right row of blocks with residual skips arching over the top and circled-plus adders.
insights.data: Inputs are rounded pills at the left edge ('Encoder Input', 'Seasonal Init', 'Trend Init') with tensor shapes beneath; every wire carries its seasonal / trend symbol (X_en^{l-1}, S_en^{l,1}, T_de^{l,k}), and the decoder's trend gets its own bottom lane summed by circled pluses.
insights.emphasis: Only the new blocks carry saturated fills - light green Frequency Enhanced Block and pink Frequency Enhanced Attention - against pale yellow MOE Decomp and grey Feed Forward, so the contribution reads as substitutions in a familiar Autoformer skeleton.
insights.flow: Left-to-right in each frame; one wire leaves the encoder's right end, drops down and enters the decoder's attention block as K and V, and the seasonal and trend lanes merge at a final adder to 'Output' on the right.
insights.avoid: The encoder-to-decoder wire enters the decoder frame from above and crosses its skip lines, the 'FEDformer Decoder' label collides with the trend lane, and the input pill reads 'Seasoal Init' (typo).

arrangement.units: two dashed grey rectangles (encoder band over decoder band) with repeat counts N x / M x in their top-right corners and names at lower-left
arrangement.shared: encoder output feeds the decoder's frequency-enhanced attention as K, V
